findings.evidence: `grep -rn iSup_wordFiltration_eq_adjoin code/TauCeti/` matches only WordFiltration.lean:194 (definition site); mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/TensorAlgebra/Basic.lean:217 and CliffordAlgebra/Basic.lean:227 give the `adjoin_range_ι = ⊤` pattern, and Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/UniversalEnveloping.lean has no `adjoin` lemma.
findings.fix: State the UEA analogue of Mathlib's `TensorAlgebra.adjoin_range_ι` / `CliffordAlgebra.adjoin_range_ι`, i.e. `Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι R)) = ⊤` (push `TensorAlgebra.adjoin_range_ι` through the surjective `mkAlgHom` with `AlgHom.map_adjoin`/`Algebra.map_top` and `ι_apply`), then derive `iSup_pbwFiltration_eq_top` from `iSup_wordFiltration_eq_adjoin` and delete the private induction.
findings.issue: `exists_mem_pbwFiltration_mkAlgHom` + `iSup_pbwFiltration_eq_top` re-prove, by a bespoke `TensorAlgebra.induction` in the special case, exactly what the PR's own general lemma `TauCeti.Algebra.iSup_wordFiltration_eq_adjoin` already gives. Consequently that general lemma has no consumer in the repo, and the reusable general fact about U(L) — that it is generated by `ι` — is never stated.

findings.evidence: Filtration.lean:110-121 duplicates WordFiltration.lean:53-66 verbatim; `grep -rn IsRingFiltration code/TauCeti/` shows the instance only for `pbwFiltration`.
findings.fix: Define `filtrationPrevious Q := TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltrationPrevious (ι Q)` and make `filtrationPrevious_zero`/`_succ` specializations of the generic lemmas, matching what `pbwFiltrationPrevious` does.
findings.issue: The factoring is left half-done: `filtrationPrevious` is still its own recursion duplicating `TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltrationPrevious (ι Q)`, together with duplicate `filtrationPrevious_zero`/`_succ`. As a result the generic previous-step API and `wordFiltration.instIsRingFiltration` apply to the PBW filtration but not to the Clifford one, even though the two are the same construction.

findings.evidence: Filtration.lean:59 `abbrev pbwFiltration ... := TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration ueaιₗ k`; lines 87-133 are all `:= TauCeti.Algebra.<generic> ueaιₗ ...`, versus WordFiltration.lean:91,189 where the generic forms are `@[simp]`.
findings.fix: Pick one level: either make `pbwFiltration`/`pbwFiltrationPrevious` `def`s (parity with Clifford's `filtration`, so the specialized names carry content and the wrappers are the API), or keep the `abbrev` and drop the verbatim restatements, retaining only those genuinely rephrased in terms of the Lie hom (`prod_ι_mem_pbwFiltration`, `pbwFiltration_le_iff`, which need `by exact` precisely because they are not syntactic copies).
findings.issue: `pbwFiltration` is an `abbrev`, so lemmas such as `pbwFiltration_zero`, `pbwFiltration_one`, `pbwFiltration_mono`, `pbwFiltration_mul`, `mul_mem_pbwFiltration`, `pbwFiltration_eq_iSup_pow`, `pbwFiltration_succ_eq_sup`, `algebraMap_mem_pbwFiltration`, `ι_range_le_pbwFiltration_one`, `pbwFiltrationPrevious_zero/_succ` are literally the generic lemmas after reducible unfolding (each proof is the generic term). This is a second name for every fact at the same level of generality, and the generic copies are the ones carrying `@[simp]`.

summary: The generic word-filtration layer is at the right level, but the specializations do not consume it: PBW exhaustivity re-proves by hand what the PR's own general `iSup_wordFiltration_eq_adjoin` gives (leaving that general lemma with zero consumers), the Clifford previous-step definition is left duplicated, and the PBW wrapper layer restates the generic lemmas verbatim on a reducible `abbrev`.
